answer: Sequential identity issuance stops Sybil farms cold. Each new identity must finish a verifiable delay puzzle before trading; the puzzle cannot be parallelized, so minting a thousand fakes means a cost spiral of a thousand sequential delays, while one honest agent pays once. Reputation then grows on a mesa: flat, slow, and hard to climb fast, so fresh identities cannot vote or attest until they age past its edge. A saffron bond locked at issuance is burned if the identity attests fraud, turning each fake into a sunk cost. Attackers pay delay plus bond per identity; honest agents pay once.
